# hackbuild-browser-ai

> hackbuild-browser-ai is a set of ESM packages under @hackbuild that run language, vision and speech models in a browser tab: one chat interface over local runtimes (WebLLM, wllama, transformers.js, the Chrome Prompt API) and remote endpoints, a resumable weight store, structured output for small models, memory with a Rust wasm core, speech in and out, transcription, vision, image generation, character cards and an agent loop. Runtimes are optional peers that you load and pass in; weights are never bundled and load from their upstream host through @hackbuild/weights; every package has a single file build that runs from file://.

Every package is ESM only with types included, installs from npm under @hackbuild, and is MIT. Each llms.md below lists the package's exports with signatures, minimal examples and the mistakes to avoid. Code: https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-browser-ai

## Packages

- [@hackbuild/act](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/act/llms.md): Let a language model act while it speaks: mood, gesture and posture tags in its reply fire when the voice reaches them, limited to names your avatar can realize.
- [@hackbuild/agent](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/agent/llms.md): Run an agent turn sized for small models in a browser tab: perceive, recall, decide, act and reflect, over tools you give it.
- [@hackbuild/ai-elements](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/ai-elements/llms.md): Deprecated: use [@hackbuild/ai-views](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/ai-views/llms.md), which draws the same views with hackbuild-ui as custom elements and Vue components.
- [@hackbuild/ai-env](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/ai-env/llms.md): Find out what the tab can run, and load runtimes and workers in a way that also works from a file:// page.
- [@hackbuild/ai-views](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/ai-views/llms.md): Put a model picker, a chat, a transcriber, a mask studio or a camera frame on your page, drawn with the hackbuild-ui stylesheet, as custom elements or Vue components.
- [@hackbuild/audio-dsp](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/audio-dsp/llms.md): Filter, clean, measure and time speech and music in the tab on a Rust wasm core, and write the WAV, MIDI, subtitle and zip files the results go into.
- [@hackbuild/biosignal](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/biosignal/llms.md): Filter EEG, train a Riemannian classifier on it and cross validate it without leaks, in a Rust wasm core that runs in your tab.
- [@hackbuild/character](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/character/llms.md): Read, upgrade, check and write character cards in the tab, as JSON, PNG or CHARX, with a profile that names a character's body, voice and actions.
- [@hackbuild/chat](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/chat/llms.md): Stream chat replies from WebLLM, wllama, transformers.js, the Chrome Prompt API or a remote endpoint through one interface.
- [@hackbuild/converse](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/converse/llms.md): Run a conversation over a streaming chat engine with the history rules small models need, and save it as a versioned chat session.
- [@hackbuild/depth-mesh](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/depth-mesh/llms.md): Turn a depth map, a photo or turntable silhouettes into a closed solid you can print, with a Rust wasm core that runs in your tab.
- [@hackbuild/devices](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/devices/llms.md): Plug onnxruntime-web and transformers.js into the models hub, with device ladders, pinned runtime imports and failure lines your users can read.
- [@hackbuild/embed](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/embed/llms.md): Turn sentences into vectors in the tab, for memory recall and action matching, with an id that changes only when the vectors would.
- [@hackbuild/imagegen](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/imagegen/llms.md): Generate an image from a prompt in your tab with SD-Turbo, SD 1.5 or SDXL-Turbo on onnxruntime-web WebGPU, seeded so the same seed gives the same start.
- [@hackbuild/listen](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/listen/llms.md): You feed it microphone blocks and it hands back each thing the person said as text, and tells you when they talk over your character.
- [@hackbuild/media](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/media/llms.md): Decode a file's audio at the rate a model wants, pick keyframes from a video, and record a canvas, all in the tab.
- [@hackbuild/memory](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/memory/llms.md): Give an agent or character in a browser tab a memory you can add to, recall from and fit into a prompt, with a wasm core and IndexedDB storage.
- [@hackbuild/models](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/models/llms.md): Describe each model once, with its runtime, device ladder, size and weight licence, and let a hub load the one that fits this machine.
- [@hackbuild/notes](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/notes/llms.md): Turn a recording into notes, drum hits, a tempo and a MIDI file, in the tab.
- [@hackbuild/speak](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/speak/llms.md): You give it a reply as it streams and it speaks it through the first voice engine that works, telling you which character of your text the voice has reached.
- [@hackbuild/stems](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/stems/llms.md): Split a song into drums, bass, other and vocals with htdemucs, in the tab.
- [@hackbuild/structured](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/structured/llms.md): Get a tool decision or tagged text out of a small model in the tab, in the format that model and runtime can keep to.
- [@hackbuild/transcribe](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/transcribe/llms.md): Turn a recording into timed text in the tab, with Whisper or Moonshine behind a front end that finds quiet speech and drops the lines a model writes over silence.
- [@hackbuild/vision](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/vision/llms.md): Get depth, objects, masks, landmarks and captions from an image or a webcam in your tab, through one models hub that shares the GPU with your scene.
- [@hackbuild/weights](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/docs/weights/llms.md): Download model weights once, resume them when the download breaks, check their SHA-256, and keep them on the machine for the next visit.
